name: Managers’ roles
title: Reimagining the role of managers
columns: Management in the era of AI
rows: Focused on predictability, consistency, and top-down process.
Creates psych safety for experimentation, learns in public, and models curiosity over certainty.

The shift from control to curiosity means letting go of the need for certainty, authority, and scarcity thinking. Leaders create psychological safety for learning, distribute intelligence and decision-making, and use AI to expand capacity and share knowledge across people and systems.
Understands how work gets done within current processes.
Understands how human workflows, AI systems, and data connect to create value.

The shift from knowing how things work to understanding how systems, people, and AI interact to create value. It’s about evolving from a single-domain expert to a “+ shaped” professional, anchored in expertise but fluent in data, AI. Moving from compliance driven to proactive responsible AI stewardship.
Monitors performance, assigns tasks, and ensures compliance.
Demonstrating AI learning and use. Designing human-AI workflows.

This means moving from telling to showing and from managing tasks to designing systems where people and AI thrive. Leaders model curiosity, orchestrate workflows, and foster collaboration, shifting from control and efficiency to creating conditions for focus, flow, and creativity.
